newsitem.title: PERU: Peru announces $162 mln debt accord with Russia.
newsitem.headline: Peru announces $162 mln debt accord with Russia.

text.p: Peruvian President Alberto Fujimori said his government had reached an agreement to restructure $162 million of debt with Russia.
Fujimori told a business conference in the southern city of Arequipa that the agreement ended a long-standing dispute with Russia over exactly how much it was owed by Peru.
Disagreement over exchange rates had been the main problem in the bilateral negotiations.

"We are determined to leave the country free of all these potentially explosive inheritances," said Fujimori, adding that the agreement with Russia tied up one of the final loose ends in Peru's series of foreign debt renegotiations.
He did not give more details of the agreement with Moscow.
